title: De tal manera que: describir un resultado

sections.content: De tal manera que (in such a way that, to the point that) introduces the concrete result of an action or process -- useful for showing just how far something went, not just that it happened. It's followed by the indicative when describing an actual completed result. These sentences are taken directly from the previous reading.

items.spanish: Los Actos Institucionales fueron restringiendo la actividad política, de tal manera que hacia 1968 casi no quedaba ninguna independiente.
items.english: The Institutional Acts kept restricting political activity, to such an extent that by 1968 almost none remained independent.

items.spanish: El Acto Institucional número cinco intensificó de tal manera la censura que hasta las canciones debían pasar por la revisión de censores.
items.english: Institutional Act number five intensified censorship to such a degree that even songs had to go through censors' review.

items.spanish: La economía creció de tal manera durante estos años que el periodo se conoció como el "milagro económico brasileño".
items.english: The economy grew in such a way during these years that the period became known as the "Brazilian economic miracle".

items.spanish: El proceso de apertura avanzó de tal manera que, tras la ley de amnistía de 1979, el país regresó a un gobierno civil en 1985.
items.english: The opening process advanced in such a way that, after the 1979 amnesty law, the country returned to civilian government in 1985.

sections.content: De tal manera que can split around the verb it modifies, as in intensificó de tal manera la censura que -- the phrase wraps the thing being intensified, with que introducing the result at the end.
